progression.narrative: The performance opens on B4 and dwells most on B in Phrase 1. Phrase 2 (0:12.0) introduces Gb, As, centred on B. Phrase 6 (2:20.8) introduces D, E, centred on D. Phrase 11 (3:24.3) introduces Db, centred on B. Phrase 14 (3:56.9) introduces Ds, centred on Ds. The line peaks at Db5 (542.7 Hz) at 4:41.4. It closes on the tonic (B2 → D4 → B3 → B2 → B3 → B4).
